title: The crate remembers: a Mark III picked up and set down again keeps what it learned
tier_reason: Sim code behind the unit suite, the save round-trip and the replay round-trip; git reverts it. The rule is the CEO's Q-98 ruling.
ask: WI-9 in docs/V0_2_2_PLAN.md: on collect, a learning robot's whole extra minus its errand keys is pushed onto GameState.boxed[key]; on place, the newest snapshot is popped and overlaid onto the fresh deploy; boxed is saved, restored and part of the canonical capture. The CEO's words: pick up is just repositioning, it shouldn't factory reset the robot.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-10, ruling Q-98 in chat with the chief of staff.
result: Landed on main (87fee69). GameState.boxed keeps a picked-up learning robot's whole state minus its errand of the moment, saved and restored beside the crate and part of the canonical capture; setting a Mark III down restores the most recently boxed one; a crate and its memory move together (the restore is gated the way the crate's decrement is). test_crate_remembers, 38 assertions, including the save and replay round trips and a non-player placement that leaves the box alone. The demo's output is byte-identical before and after. Two attempts: the first worker was cut off by a usage limit before committing; the second started fresh. Chief of staff verified on a clean checkout of main after the merge.
